description: This is a test class for the LocaleTools utility, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of applying locale settings to an Android context across different API levels.

classes.name: LocaleToolsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing locale application functionality in Android contexts, covering different API levels and edge cases.

methods.name: setUpLocale
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting the default locale to US and obtaining the application context.

methods.name: tearDownLocale
methods.description: Resets the locale to US after each test.

methods.name: testSetAndResetValueAPI21
methods.description: Tests applying a new locale ('ru') and resetting it on API level 21, verifying display names and locale settings.

methods.name: testSetAndResetValueAPI24
methods.description: Tests applying a new locale ('ru') and resetting it on API level 24, verifying display names, locale list size, and fallback behavior.

methods.name: testSetEmptyValue
methods.description: Tests applying an empty string as locale, ensuring it defaults to the system locale and that the language is not empty.
